line.text: 陛下，今天是一七八九年七月十三日。

shots.sound: his voice, a quiet palace room

shots.image: {KING}, sitting up in the bed in the centre of the frame, facing the camera, right hand resting on the wig, mouth fully visible.
shots.location: Inside a lavish royal bedchamber at Versailles in 1789: carved gilded wood wall panels, a large bed with a gold-fringed canopy and white pillows. Warm morning daylight falls from frame left. Plain unmarked surfaces, no paintings with writing.

line.text: 一七八九……明天巴士底監獄就要被攻破了！
line.lead: lowers his right hand to his chest

shots.camera: Very slow push toward his face, his mouth fully in frame.
shots.sound: his voice, a quiet palace room

shots.image: {KING}, sitting behind the desk in the centre of the frame, facing the camera, both hands resting on the desk. {MINISTER}, standing at the desk on the left side of the frame, facing frame right, holding a palm-sized brass padlock in both hands. In the middle of the desk sits a small open wooden box the size of a shoebox holding dismantled locks and small tools.

line.where: the thin grey-haired man on the left
line.text: 陛下，今天還要繼續修鎖嗎？
line.after: He sets the padlock down on the right side of the desk.

listener.where: the man in the wig behind the desk
listener.react: glances at the padlock and keeps his hands on the desk

shots.framing: Medium close-up, waist up, eye level.
shots.image: {KING}, sitting behind the desk in the centre of the frame, facing the camera, both hands on the desk; the small open wooden box of dismantled locks sits in the middle of the desk in front of him. Only this one person is in the frame.
shots.location: Inside a royal study at Versailles in 1789: a dark wooden writing desk in the middle ground, carved wood wall panels, a tall window on the right wall. Warm morning daylight falls from the window on frame right. Plain unmarked surfaces.

line.text: 不修鎖了，先修財政。把帳本拿來！
line.lead: pushes the box of locks to the left side of the desk with his right hand
line.after: He presses his right palm flat on the desk.

shots.sound: his voice, a palm slapping the desk

shots.framing: Medium close-up, waist up, eye level.

line.text: 赤字這麼大……宮裡的開銷先砍一半。

line.text: 舞會取消。改辦一場……全國工程師大會！
